description.vi: Cách Đầu mối biến mục tiêu của đội thành việc mỗi tuần: cam kết đầu tuần, check-in cuối tuần, nhìn lại cuối chu kỳ. Không gắn với công ty hay sản phẩm nào.
description.en: How a team's Đầu mối turns the team's goals into tasks each week: Monday commitments, a Friday check-in and a cycle review. Tied to no company or product.

skills.name: coordinator-rhythm
skills.description: Load it when a recurring cadence task reaches you as the team's Đầu mối (the weekly commitments, the weekly check-in, the cycle review), or when a goal of your team changes: read the team's goals, last check-in, open tasks and signals, then commit at most a few tasks each linked to a goal, cancel or park tasks that serve no active goal, check in with a value, a confidence and one sentence, score the cycle, and propose next cycle's team goals as drafts.
